question: The validity of a medical prescription extends:

options.opa: To the territorial area marked by each Health Center.
options.opb: To the territorial scope of each Autonomous Community.
options.opd: To the territorial area defined by each Health Area.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Medical prescription -> legal document -> regulated by national laws -> 95% CHAIN: Health Center -> local healthcare facility -> limited geographical area -> 80% CHAIN: Autonomous Community -> regional government -> healthcare regulations -> 85% CHAIN: National territory -> entire country -> uniform healthcare laws -> 90% CHAIN: Health Area -> administrative division -> specific healthcare services -> 95%
